name: TRAPPIST-1g
tagline: La plus grande des sept — une super-Terre fraîche à l'ancre externe de la chaîne.
history: TRAPPIST-1g is the biggest sibling — a touch larger and heavier than Earth — and sits near the outer edge of the temperate zone where only a thick atmosphere could resist freezing. Together with f and h it closes out the resonant chain: seven planets whose periods stand in neat integer ratios, a signpost that the whole family migrated inward together from the system's icy outskirts. Its mass is among the best measured, from the way its orbit tugs its neighbors early and late.
